Atomic File Manager · App icon · 10 variations

One folder. Ten atoms.

Study 50's Markdown folder, rebuilt for Atomic: the # is now the atom mark, and every colour, border and shadow comes from the Atomic design system. Ink on paper, one Signal, hard offset shadows, no blur. Each icon has a light and a dark version, shown here at 128, 48 and 24 px.

Ink #15171B Paper #F4F5F1 Signal #3A2FF0 On ink #8F88FF Deep #1D14A0 Mist #D8D6FF
→

Started from study 50, “Markdown Folder”, in LLMiser's palette.

VARIATION 01HARD SHADOW 6/128

Paper & Signal

The brand default: ink on paper, with a single Signal atom where the # was.

VARIATION 02HARD SHADOW 6/128

Signal Folder

Loud on purpose: a Signal folder carrying a white atom, deep-blue shadow.

VARIATION 03HARD SHADOW 6/128

Ink Folder

The dark-section look: ink folder, signal-light atom, Signal shadow.

VARIATION 04HARD SHADOW 3/128

Line Folder

Outline only, like Atomic's stroke icons, lifted on a Signal slab.

VARIATION 05HARD SHADOW 6/128

Atomic Coin

The Atomic Coin set into the folder front, with its deep-blue offset disc.

VARIATION 06HARD SHADOW 6/128

Open Folder

The atom rising out of an open folder: opening a folder is the core action.

VARIATION 07HARD SHADOW 3/128

Stacked

Two folders deep, for a manager of many folders.

VARIATION 08HARD SHADOW 6/128

Storage Meter

The atom over a storage bar, the first thing Home answers.

VARIATION 09NO SHADOW

Mono Knockout

One colour with the atom cut out, for themed and monochrome icons.

VARIATION 10HARD SHADOW 6/128

Dot Grid Tab

A Signal tab on Atomic's dot grid: quiet, with one loud detail.

Files: Atomic-File-Manager/docs/design/icon-variations/, with an SVG (128 × 128) and a 512 px PNG of every variation in both themes. Pick the ones worth developing and send the list back. The chosen icon can then become an Android adaptive icon with foreground, background and monochrome layers.
